10th European Congress of Methodology (EAM2023): registration

The 10th European Congress of Methodology (EAM2023) will be held July
11-13, 2023 at Ghent University. The aim of the conference is to bring
together specialists in methodology, statistics and data analysis in the
fields of Behavioral, Social, Educational, Health and Economic Sciences,
as well as in Evaluation research. Topics range from design and data
collection to statistical analysis, including latent variable modeling,
longitudinal and multilevel modeling, and causal inference.

Registration is now open!

For further information see the website at https://eam2023.ugent.be/

With kind regards,
Yves Rosseel
Chair local organization committee.
